decisions.title: Ship Nocturne as the only theme
decisions.chosen: Replace the light theme entirely; no light/dark toggle
decisions.rationale: Single theme keeps the renderer simple and the bundle small. No JS needed for a toggle.
decisions.alternatives: Ship both themes behind a toggle

decisions.title: Use system font stack for Inter
decisions.chosen: Map the design's Inter to the OS system font stack
decisions.rationale: Self-containment contract forbids external requests, so Google Fonts is out. Note: <script>alert(1)</script> payload here to prove escaping.
